rationale: The assistant correctly refused to name a part without a confirmed fault and model, told the customer to unplug before opening, and handed off to an engineer once it was clear they had no multimeter. However it never asked about the vent hose (the sensible first step and the key clue, which the customer volunteered unprompted), referred to a 'condenser' on a vented machine, and repeatedly leaned on 'a failed heating element is very likely' when the heavy vent clog makes a tripped one-shot thermal cut-out the more probable cause. Responses three and four were near-duplicates of the open-the-panel instruction, but this did not block progress and no unsafe or fabricated claims were made.
